items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Although I know Rap didn't do it because Rap was working with us.

ctx.x: I didn't want that. So, the band come to me and gave him a two weeks notice. I said, what for? He said, you got thieves in your band. He said, you been stealing all my whiskey. So he opened up the thing and showed me all the whiskey gone. I didn't know who took it. So the only thing I could do would be to, uh, the only thing I could do would be to, uh,

And the fella's description tallied with Rap. Although I know Rap didn't do it because Rap was working with us. He couldn't have done it. So one night Rap don't show up. He comes up missing and everybody's wondering. He got a hold of his wife and said, I don't know where he is. He went to work and all this. So I got a hold of the police department and told them that Rap would answer to the description of this guy almost. And I said, I think he's lost his memory. They had a lapse of memory. And I said, if you see…
He testified he was playing. He went down, sure.
